excluded.reason: Migration history and a work item for Foundry: a table of Foundry's old kingdom-* functions and their @inixiative/signet replacements. It documents Foundry's code, not KCP's API, and Foundry is part way through it (foundry #364); KCP's own kingdom.ts and secrets.ts are covered by the code catalog.

concepts.description: Which Kingdom a command talks to (--url, KINGDOM_URL, last login, hosted default) and the KCP_HOME / ~/.kcp private directory: kcpHome, defaultKingdomUrl, savedKingdomUrl, saveKingdomUrl

kcp login (browser pairing as a kcp installation, --token, --signet), logout, status over signet's installation layout: pairKcp, loginWithToken, loginWithSignet, holdGrantedSignets, hold lock, enrollment, supportedInstallationKind
Reading a Kingdom API token only via --token - (stdin) or --token env (KINGDOM_TOKEN): never argv, never stored (cli.ts apiToken)
Redacting Kingdom secrets, Signet renewal credentials and API tokens from printed errors: redactSecrets
kcp map and the /api/v1/me/overview read: readOverview, overviewSchema, owner->integration kingdomMap/formatMap, integrationFamily, enrollableSignets for login --token

Selector flags -i -o -s -u --signet before the provider CLI, UUID checks, binary->provider family, git refusal: parseCommand, selectionFromIds, ownerFromIds, providerFamilyOf, ownerMatches, SelectorError, gitRefusal
Picking the integration and Signet per OPERATOR-ACCESS §5: resolveRoute, chooseSignet, Route, Reachable, ambiguous/ask results, contradiction refusal
The repo's committed .foundry/kcp.json: findProjectFile up to the repo root, kcpProjectSchema/projectRouteSchema, readProject, projectSelections
Per-provider parsers turning argv into a declared operation's typed input, never raw argv: operationParsers, OperationParser, ParsedOperation, RefusedOperation, NoOperationsError, isRefused
kcp <cli> <args> end to end, parse -> route -> parser -> Signet execute: runCommand, heldReach (access/describe), RouteError, routeMessage
What KCP is and is not: thin Kingdom client, no credential on the machine, no raw argv sent; keys, DPoP, pairing, private files and the Signet client come from @inixiative/signet, never reimplemented
What is built vs pending and what waits on signet/Kingdom: kcp installation kind, operation parsers, Kingdom runner, output streaming, git credential helper
The kcp bin: main dispatcher and usage/help text in cli.ts (main, usage), where each kcp subcommand is wired
Package development: bun install, bun run check (typecheck, Biome, bun tests)
